messages:
maya: Heads-up: mapping dependency chain for the 'edge-adaptive-routing' roadmap item. Need eng/infra/runtime/security signoff on SLA and launch sequencing. Can we do a quick thread to align owners + blockers? TL;DR: scale + KMS for per-tenant keys may shift sequence.

ravi: I'm in. Can you attach current spec or the delta from MVP? Need to know expected req/sec and tail latency SLOs.

maya: Delta: add per-tenant routing rules + fallback model variant. Expected peak ~12k reqs/s, 95p latency target < 120ms/token. Will add doc link: https://redwood.internal/specs/edge-adaptive-routing (placeholder).

jamal: Runtime note: continuous batching helps cost but increases p95. For 12k we need at least 8 GPUs with prewarm. Also KV cache size per-tenant will blow memory unless we shard. Owner: runtime-team (cc @ravi).

sofia: Security: per-tenant KMS keys required. HSM integration ~2-3w + audit. Also need to scope data flow & PII handling for customer sample datasets. Owner: security. If HSM is required, sequence flips: security -> infra -> runtime.

ravi: Ok. Decision point: can we accept soft-SLA for first wave (p95 < 300ms) if we ship without HSM? That would let product ship while security finishes KMS. @sofia?

sofia: We can allow soft-SLA for EAP (internal + trusted customers) only. Must include explicit opt-in and enhanced logging. No full prod availability without HSM + KMS audit.

maya: Product proposal: two-stage launch. Stage 1: EAP with soft-SLA (300ms) + feature flag + opt-in customers. Stage 2: full GA with HSM, strict SLO (120ms) and tenant keys. Timeline: stage1 = 6w, stage2 = +4w after HSM ready.

jamal: Runtime tasks for stage1: kv-sharding change, batching policy tweak, prewarm plan. I can scope a runbook & cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. Example prewarm command:
```\n# prewarm script\n./prewarm --model=redwood-13b --replicas=8 --warmup=60\n```

ravi: Infra tasks: capacity reservations + networking + quota. If stage2 needs HSM, infra must provision HSM infra and KMS connectors; estimate 3w + security review. I'll open infra ticket and tag owners.

maya: Great. Action items: maya -> finalize product-stage doc + customer list; jamal -> runtime runbook + cost; ravi -> infra ticket & reservation; sofia -> HSM audit & gating checklist. Anyone want to add/change owners?

jamal: :thumbsup: I'll add risk items (cache thrash, cold-start).

sofia: I'll draft the gating checklist tomorrow morning. Also request: include a rolling rollback plan and data-retention note.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-6142 'edge-adaptive routing infra reservations' and linked to this thread.

ravi: Thanks. I'll post the infra ticket number in 30m. For now, can everyone react if they agree with the two-stage plan? :eyes: 

maya: Agree. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Agree. :white_check_mark:

sofia: Agree for EAP gating but not GA without HSM. :white_check_mark:

ravi: Noted. I'll set up a 30-min sync tomorrow with runtime/infra/security to firm up schedule. Tentative: 11am PT.
